response.query: What plausible natural experiments or instruments (donor eligibility cutoffs, grant rollouts, regulatory shock dates, exchange-control changes) exist in candidate jurisdictions?
response.answer: Donor eligibility cutoffs in grant programs and regulatory shock dates from 1957 elections in Sierra Leone serve as plausible natural experiments. Exchange-control changes in post-colonial economies also provide useful instruments.
